ideas.pitch: Satellite-based environmental and campus infrastructure monitoring dashboard tailored for Blacksburg and surrounding areas.
ideas.title: HokiesEcoMonitor

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and campus resource routing platform leveraging local RAG to aggregate student services.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of greennovation-ai-platform by combining LangGraph and structured RAG into an immediate, functional student-facing utility.

ideas.pitch: Graph intelligence and risk-scoring platform designed for local regional banks and agricultural supply chains in Virginia.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the proven architecture of Bito by incorporating graph-based risk intelligence and transparent explainability, appealing strongly to judges looking for enterprise utility.
